Unfortunately, no. You're within the 14-day window (day 10), but the Leafy Plus refund only applies if you haven't used any benefits. Since you've used the free shipping once, you're not eligible for a refund.

- **If you cancel:** you won't get a refund, but your benefits continue until the end of the paid year. These include free Standard shipping with no minimum, free change-of-mind returns, the 90-day plant guarantee, 10% member pricing on pots and accessories, and early access to rare plant drops.
- **Auto-renewal:** Leafy Plus renews automatically, so cancelling will stop future renewals. The knowledge base doesn't say exactly where to cancel, so I can't point you to a specific menu. If you need help with that, I can escalate.

If you'd like to request an exception because of your circumstances, let me know and I'll escalate it to a Support Lead. I can't promise the outcome, since it's outside the standard policy.
